SELECT DISTINCT
    r."name",
    r."address",
    r."service_format",
    r."hours"
FROM "restaurant" r
WHERE (
        LOWER(r."service_format") LIKE '%buffet%'
        OR LOWER(r."service_format") LIKE '%coffee%'
      )
  
  AND (
        
        (regexp_match(r."hours", '(\d{1,2}:\d{2})'))[1]::time <= '07:30'::time
        AND (regexp_match(r."hours", '(\d{1,2}:\d{2})\s*[-–—]\s*(\d{1,2}:\d{2})'))[2]::time >= '16:00'::time
      )
ORDER BY r."name" ASC NULLS FIRST;

JOIN "reviews" r ON r."hotelid" = h."hotelid"
GROUP BY h."hotelid"
ORDER BY h."hotelid" ASC NULLS FIRST;

312:

FROM "sous_chef" sc

JOIN "orders" o ON o."restaurant_id" = r."restaurant_id"
JOIN "order_details" od ON od."order_id" = o."order_id"
JOIN "menu_items" mi ON mi."menu_item_id" = od."menu_item_id"

   OR mi."item_name" LIKE '%Pizza%'
